examples.arabic: كنت جايبه معايا تفاح و مانجة من السوق ليها
examples.english: I had brought apples and mangoes from the market for her.
examples.transliteration: kont gayba ma'aya toffah w manga men es souq leha

examples.arabic: سألت البياع بكام المانجة دي كلها
examples.english: I asked the seller how much all these mangoes were.
examples.transliteration: Sa'alt el bayyaa' bekam el manga di kolaha.
